modules.title: Strategic Approach To International Business
modules.summary: This course focuses on developing a strategic perspective on conducting business in a global context. The course covers a range of topics, including global strategy development, strategic alliance formation, risk management, and cultural intelligence. Students in this course will learn how to analyze global market trends and develop effective strategies for managing cross-border business operations. They will also gain a deeper understanding of the cultural and institutional differences that shape international business environments and learn how to apply this knowledge to make strategic decisions in a global context. By the end of the course, students will have developed a strategic mindset that will enable them to excel in international business.
